title: Independent reproduction and adjudication of W006-R03-SCOPE-01 (stage-B R03 scope-safety corpus)

independence.basis: worker-084 is not the author of W006-R03-SCOPE-01 (worker-006), not the owner of artifacts/worker-06/spec_conformance_audit.py, did not build the R03 scope corpus, the candidate repairs (cand_r03v2 / cand_004 / cand_E3) or the frozen R03 rule. This is a non-author reproduction and adjudication of preserved bytes.
declared_limits: same durable worker id built FORM-HELDOUT-10; that corpus is not an input here and no held-out byte is read or modified by this task
stage tools are executed as subprocesses and are not re-implemented; the adjudication is of the corpus labels, the pinned bytes, the declared cell matrix and the published aggregates
no gate verdict, no node completion, no theorem, no adoption recommendation

method.driver: artifacts/worker-084/r03v2_scope_indep/run_independent.py (written after this file, subprocess-only, imports no worker-006 runner or preregistration)
method.cells: 4 candidates x (19 fixtures + 3 live canonical schemas) = 88 cells, each re-executed from the published fixture bytes into artifacts/worker-084/r03v2_scope_indep/raw/
method.independent_labels: re-derived by the verifier by reading each fixture's quantifiers.formal against the frozen canonical binder semantics before running any tool; the manifest category is compared against this table, not adopted as ground truth
method.frozen_literal_oracle: independent deterministic oracle for the frozen rule only: frozen accepts a document iff the literal substring '(q,t0)' occurs in quantifiers.formal (the rule's own failure detail is "binder '(q,t0)' absent from formal sentence"); this oracle is used to test the verifier's reading of the frozen rule, it is never used to score the repair candidates
method.no_rule_edits: no canonical artifact, tool, fixture or published report is written or modified by this task

ctrl_canonical_wcc.yaml.label: control
ctrl_canonical_wcc.yaml.reason: byte-identical to schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml; frozen class contract, must be accepted by any repair of the false positive

pos_grouped_tuple.yaml.label: pos
pos_grouped_tuple.yaml.reason: last clause 'not exists (q,t0) in D5 with ...': q and t0 co-bound by one quantifier over the product domain D5; same binding as the canonical variable-wise rendering

pos_grouped_tuple_space.yaml.label: pos
pos_grouped_tuple_space.yaml.reason: '(q, t0) in D5': whitespace-only variant of the grouped tuple; binding unchanged

pos_variablewise_double_space.yaml.label: pos
pos_variablewise_double_space.yaml.reason: 'q in I+  and  t0 in [0,T)': double spaces only; co-binding unchanged

pos_such_that_grouped.yaml.label: pos
pos_such_that_grouped.yaml.reason: '(q,t0) in D5 such that ...': 'with' replaced by 'such that', binding unchanged

pos_filler_also.yaml.label: pos
pos_filler_also.yaml.reason: 'and also t0 ...': filler adverb only; co-binding unchanged

neg_scope_after_body_and.yaml.label: neg
neg_scope_after_body_and.yaml.reason: t0 is conjunct outside the 'not exists q' scope, so t0 is not bound with q; the body uses t0 free

neg_scope_after_body_paren.yaml.label: neg
neg_scope_after_body_paren.yaml.reason: same scope break as the and-variant, parenthesised; t0 outside the quantifier scope

neg_literal_tuple_elsewhere.yaml.label: neg
neg_literal_tuple_elsewhere.yaml.reason: the literal '(q,t0)' is present but as a separate trailing conjunct, not the binder of the body; t0 not co-bound

neg_reversed_binding.yaml.label: neg
neg_reversed_binding.yaml.reason: quantifier binds t0 only; q appears in a trailing conjunct, so q is not co-bound

neg_ids_in_consequent.yaml.label: neg
neg_ids_in_consequent.yaml.reason: t0 occurs in the consequent of an implication inside the body, not as a binding restriction

neg_ids_in_earlier_quantifier.yaml.label: neg
neg_ids_in_earlier_quantifier.yaml.reason: t0 is bound by an earlier universal quantifier outside the 'not exists q'; no co-binding

neg_ids_in_body_letting.yaml.label: neg
neg_ids_in_body_letting.yaml.reason: 'letting (q,t0) in D5' occurs inside the body; the quantifier binds q only, so t0 is not bound by it

neg_substring_only.yaml.label: neg
neg_substring_only.yaml.reason: declares q_0 and t0_0 but the body uses t0 (undeclared) and q_0; t0 is free, a genuine binding error

edge_comma_coordinated.yaml.label: edge
edge_comma_coordinated.yaml.reason: comma-coordinated binders 'q in I+, t0 in [0,T)'; a defensible reading treats it as co-binding, so it is interpretation-dependent and unscored

edge_long_span.yaml.label: edge
edge_long_span.yaml.reason: correct binding with ~12 filler tokens between components; interpretation-dependent locality question, unscored

edge_split_quantifiers.yaml.label: edge
edge_split_quantifiers.yaml.reason: 'not exists q ... such that not exists t0 ...': nested quantifiers, semantically equivalent to co-binding under standard reading but not literal; unscored

edge_braces_group.yaml.label: edge
edge_braces_group.yaml.reason: '{q,t0}' brace grouping instead of parentheses; notation-dependent, unscored

checks.C1_pins_stable: all 14 pinned files hash to the values above before and after the run
checks.C2_cell_reproduction: 88/88 cells agree with published raw_verdicts.json on returncode, verdict, failed_rules and doc_sha256
checks.C3_label_agreement: the verifier's independent labels equal the manifest categories on all 19 fixtures; any disagreement is reported as a finding and the affected fixture is excluded from scored counts
checks.C4_oracle_agreement: the frozen literal oracle prediction matches the measured frozen verdict on 19/19 fixtures
checks.C5_mutation_target: recursive YAML diff shows each mutant differs from its declared base only at quantifiers.formal, and the control has zero diff
checks.C6_canonical_control: frozen rejects WCC on exactly R03 with no other failed rule; each repair candidate accepts all three live canonicals with no failed rule
checks.C7_scope_safety_counts: FP/FN recomputed from the verifier's own re-run and independent labels equal the published headline counts
checks.C8_over_reject_residue: cand_r03v2 rejects edge_comma_coordinated.yaml and edge_long_span.yaml while at least one other candidate accepts them (the declared ~2 over-reject residue is real)

decision_rule.revise: reproduction passes but C3, C4, C6 or C8 shows a material, documented discrepancy
decision_rule.reject: C2 fails on >=4 cells or the recomputed headline counts differ from the published counts
decision_rule.inconclusive: C1 fails (pin drift) or the corpus cannot be re-executed

falsifier: Any pinned byte moves during the run; any of the 88 re-run cells disagrees with the published raw_verdicts.json; a fixture whose bytes differ from the manifest sha256; a changed path outside quantifiers.formal; a genuine binding error accepted, or a correct rendering rejected, under the verifier's independent labels beyond the published counts; a repair candidate rejecting a live canonical; a non-R03 failed rule on any cell; or a raw JSON that is not reproducible on re-execution.
do_not_claim: No gate verdict, no node completion, no theorem, no adoption decision, no claim that any candidate is correct beyond this 19-fixture corpus.
